T: Everybody talks. Nobody touches Terri's apple juice.
D: On a busy Saturday, a barbershop owner on Chicago's South Side has second thoughts about selling the shop.
P: Serve the drinks when Terri finds out someone drank her apple juice.
S: Hot sauce butter kettle chips with ranch
the snacks on the counter between haircuts

Thick kettle chips tossed warm in hot sauce butter, lime zest and salt, served with a cool buttermilk ranch dip for dunking. Melt 40g butter with 3 tbsp hot sauce and the zest of a lime. Spread 2 bags of kettle chips on a tray, drizzle with the butter, toss and warm at 160C for 4 minutes. For the dip, whisk 150g sour cream, 100ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and dill, half a tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper. Serve the chips warm with the ranch.
JD and Billy and the ATM they can't crack

Spicy smoked sausages grilled slowly over coals until blistered and hot through, sliced thick and served on toothpicks with yellow mustard and pickled jalapeños. Grill 8 hot smoked sausages slowly over medium coals, turning often, until the skins blister and they are hot right through. Slice thickly on an angle and spear each piece with a toothpick. Serve with a bowl of yellow mustard and pickled jalapenos on the side.
the tamale man doing the rounds of the South Side
Corn masa wrapped around spiced beef, steamed in husks for an hour, served with hot sauce.
M: the shop his dad left him

Pork rib tips rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, roasted at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tangy barbecue sauce, piled on white bread with fries. Rub 1.5kg pork ribs cut into short pieces with smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic and salt. Cover and roast at 150C for 2.5 hours. Uncover, brush with tangy barbecue sauce and roast hot until sticky. Pile over slices of white bread with oven fries.

Beef topside roasted rare, sliced paper thin and dunked in garlic and oregano beef jus, piled into soft rolls with hot pickled giardiniera. Rub 1kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and 1 tsp oregano and roast at 200C for 35 minutes to rare. Rest and chill for an hour, then slice paper thin. Simmer 1L beef stock with 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 15 minutes. Drop the beef into the jus for 1 minute, pile into 4 split long rolls, spoon over jus and top with giardiniera.
W: a slice from the bakery down the road
Roasted sweet potato mashed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, evaporated milk and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: Cloudy apple juice shaken with fresh ginger and lime, poured over ice and topped with soda, each bottle labelled with a name so nobody steals it. Grate a 4cm knob of ginger and squeeze the juice into a big jug through a sieve. Add 1L cloudy apple juice and the juice of 2 limes and stir. Pour into four bottles, add ice and top each with 100ml soda water. Write a name on each bottle in marker so nobody else touches it, then serve with lime wedges.

s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin. Beat 300g masa harina with 100g lard, 1 tsp baking powder and 400ml warm stock to a soft dough. Spread on 16 soaked corn husks, add beef, roll up and steam 60 minutes. Serve with hot sauce.

w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, then mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked sweet shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 50 minutes until just set. Cool completely before slicing.
